messages:
Alex K: Quick sync — I sketched an SLO/heuristics proposal for GPU decommissioning and region-specific health scoring. Want feedback before I wire it into Grafana panels and alert rules.
Priya R: dropping in — curious how you want to handle transient Xid spikes vs persistent ECC increases.
Alex K: good Q. idea: two-tier signals — (1) transient: Xid bursts that clear within 30m => warning only, track counts; (2) persistent: sustained ECC/Xid elevation over 3h or repeated reboots => auto-drain candidate.
Maria S: sounds reasonable. we should also tie to node-level flakiness metric i.e. "swap-to-cold" count or container restarts that correlate with GPU errors.
Sam T: +1. Also need region weight — e.g., ap-south has smaller spare pool so we bias towards replacement slower there to avoid capacity loss.
Jin L: Can we express the persistent condition in PromQL? I mocked something: 
```
max_over_time(increase(nvidia_xid_errors_total[10m])[3h:10m]) > 5
```
that flags GPUs with repeated 10m bursts over the last 3h.
Leah M: that looks noisy. maybe combine with a smoothed rate and uptime check: if gpu_reboots_total increased in same window, escalate.
Alex K: agreed. proposed composite rule: persistent = (smoothed_xid_rate > 0.1/sec for 3h) OR (ecc_increase > 3 in 3h AND gpu_reboots > 0). fallback: short-lived Xid bursts raise priority=low only.
Priya R: for Grafana UI, can we add a per-region healthscore card that shows: health (0-100), recent ECC count, last reboot, pending-drain flag, and replacement budget used? would help oncall triage.
Maria S: yes — panel columns: gpu_id, host, healthscore, ecc_6h, xid_6h, reboots_24h, pending_drain, last_seen. healthscore calc idea: 100 - min(60, weighted(ECC*2 + XID*3 + reboot*15 + flakiness*25)).
Sam T: curious about SLO targets — what do we commit to? region-level 99.9% healthy GPUs? or per-cluster?
Alex K: brainstorm: SLO "Region GPU availability" = % of GPUs not marked for emergency replacement or offline for hardware faults. target 99.8 monthly for primary regions, 99.5 for small/edge. We surface burn rate in the console.
Leah M: costs: if we aggressively replace GPUs, we burn spare budget and increase replacement ops. We should add a "replacement budget" per region: e.g., 2% of fleet monthly for apac, 4% for na. replacement actions above budget require pager + EM approval.
Jin L: infra-bot: can you record a ticket when pending_drain transitions to auto-replace?
infra-bot: Created ticket INF-4789 linking gpu_id and last_10_errors. Auto-replace workflow will require two approvers if region_budget_exceeded = true.
Priya R: action items: 1) Alex: commit Grafana dashboard PR with healthscore panel + example PromQLs. 2) Jin: refine PromQLs to reduce noise. 3) Maria: add replacement budget fields to region metadata. 4) Sam/Leah: define approval flow for budget-exceed replaces.
Alex K: I'll put up a small branch today. Quick note on panels: include a toggle to view only "pending_drain" GPUs and a histogram of time-to-drain after first ECC/Xid signal.
Maria S: + add a compact panel that maps GPU health to model-serving latency regressions (to prove user impact).
Sam T: if nobody objects I'll put a placeholder SLO doc in confluence with the numbers above and link to the dashboard.
Priya R: no objections from me. one more ask: can we surface per-model routing fallback counts when a region loses >1% healthy GPUs — helps product reason about degradation.
Alex K: good call. I'll include an alt-routing metric and link. thanks all, will post PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
Leah M: thanks. if the PR touches alerting, please add a staging rollout for 24h before prod.
Alex K: noted. targeting rollout next Tue to staging then gradual prod ramp.
infra-bot: Scheduled rollout job: rollout/1829001234-gpu-healthscore -> staging at 2026-03-24T02:00Z
